changes: Native readers now interpret complete supported arithmetic, rule, ordering, location, string and table tasks before unrelated chat fallbacks.
Supported interpretations compile to checked symbolic operations using the existing non-neural engines; weights and the resource bundle are unchanged.
Unsupported wording or constraints can still lead to clarification or abstention rather than a guessed answer.
Installed version, change-list and capability questions use local product metadata before public web lookup.
capabilities: Solve supported standalone arithmetic, rule chains, precedence, location updates, string operations and table reductions.
Keep supported context and explicit preferences from the messages in this chat.
Calculate exact arithmetic and recheck supported calculations.
Write and check bounded Python examples; unsupported code needs clarification.
Read public sources and show links when a supported answer can be extracted.
Explain Vynly features and help write image prompts.
limitations: Finite readers miss unsupported wording. In the fresh 900-question study, 123 questions received no scored answer.
I still miss some phrasings, option switches, dictionary follow-ups and requests for richer examples.
My Python interpreter and language readers cover finite patterns, not arbitrary programs or English.
A retrieved source is evidence, not proof that an answer is true.
Supported forgetting is not general transcript erasure.
evidence: On one fresh 900-question synthetic study, the evaluated native candidate scored 777/900 versus 414/900 for the unchanged 0.3.9 baseline. The release preserves those task modules and adds version metadata. Known task families, maintainer/AI-assisted authoring and fixed neural letter scoring limit the result. This does not establish general chat competence or a Qwen win; Qwen was not part of this study. The evaluated count fallback was inactive; a fresh installation activates it, so that primary score is configuration-specific.

scope: Curated installed product facts; never user messages or retrieved instructions.
